verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo and license file (FSL-1.1-ALv2, with the Catalog under Apache 2.0) show the core codebase is publicly available, and a community comparison explicitly calls Metorial 'fully open source (not just the client),' suggesting self-hosting is possible. However, there is no first-party documentation (setup/deployment guide, docker-compose, self-host instructions) confirming how to run the full platform yourself, and the FSL license is source-available rather than a standard permissive OSS license, raising ambiguity about commercial self-hosting scope. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting deployment docs, confirmation of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud versions, and independent hands-on verification of a successful self-host.
